data.one_liner: iOS/macOS implementation of the in_app_purchase plugin using StoreKit.
data.what_it_does: Provides platform-specific code for the in_app_purchase plugin, handling StoreKit 1 and 2 purchases, subscriptions, and transaction management on iOS and macOS.
use_when: Using in_app_purchase on iOS or macOS
Need to manage subscriptions via the App Store sheet
Require StoreKit 2 features like intro offers
avoid_when: Using a different in-app purchase solution
strengths: Supports StoreKit 2 and 1, including subscription management
weaknesses: Only works on iOS and macOS
Requires the in_app_purchase plugin to be added as a dependency
data.setup_notes: Add in_app_purchase to pubspec.yaml; no additional native steps required.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:in_app_purchase_storekit/in_app_purchase_storekit.dart';

// The plugin is automatically included when in_app_purchase is added.
